text.tspan: Total population living in extreme poverty by world region
Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $3 per day. This data is adjusted for
inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. It relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per
